input: Research home birth midwifery options in my area

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The user's location entirely determines which midwives and practices are relevant — without it, no research can be targeted.
Knowing how far along the pregnancy is shapes urgency and which aspects to prioritise — availability, first consultations, or backup hospital agreements.
Whether this is for a first birth or a subsequent one affects the type of midwife care needed and the risk profile providers will consider.
Budget and insurance coverage heavily influence which midwives are viable options — certified nurse-midwives vs. direct-entry midwives have very different cost and coverage profiles.
The user may have strong preferences around birth philosophy, such as water birth support, natural/unmedicated focus, or specific cultural or religious considerations, which narrows the shortlist.
The user may want a simple list of names, a full comparison of credentials and reviews, or guidance on what questions to ask midwives — the depth of output changes the whole plan.
Knowing whether the user wants to do this research themselves (with a guide), have it done for them, or take an immediate next step like booking a consultation determines the format of the plan.

gold.taskTitle: Research local home birth midwifery options
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate home birth midwife options available in the user's local area.

questions.title: What city or region are you searching in?
questions.description: Identifies the geographic area so that all research is locally relevant and actionable.

questions.title: How many weeks pregnant are you right now?
questions.description: Establishes urgency and determines which stages of the hiring process to prioritise.

questions.title: Will this be your first birth or have you given birth before?
questions.description: Shapes the type of midwifery care and risk level that providers will factor into accepting you as a client.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget or insurance situation for midwifery care?
questions.description: Determines whether to focus on insurance-billable certified nurse-midwives, out-of-pocket direct-entry midwives, or both.

questions.title: Do you have specific birth preferences, such as water birth or a particular philosophy?
questions.description: Filters the shortlist to midwives whose practice style and offerings match what the user values most.

questions.title: What does a useful end result look like — a shortlist, a comparison, or something else?
questions.description: Defines the depth and format of research output so the plan matches the user's actual need.

questions.title: Do you want to book a consultation, or just gather information for now?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the immediate next action is outreach and scheduling or purely informational research.
